svg.title: What the page draws in one second, in three states
svg.desc: Three strips, each one second of screen time. With rain in the forecast the strip holds 24 marks: the rain moves in 24 steps a second, not 60, by design. With nothing moving the strip is a flat line: 0 frames drawn in 10 seconds and the app at 0.0 % CPU, measured on the television on 3 and 4 November 2026. With another app in front there is no page to draw: scripts paused, 5.8 MB held and no browser view, measured on 3 November 2026 with an HDMI input in front.
svg.text: One second of screen time, in three states

g.text: By design, in the page's code.
Measured 3 Nov 2026, HDMI input in front.
